title: Open Reconciliation Wizard in Ledgers
description: Answer: How do I open reconciliation wizard? This is the canonical Ledgers workflow for open-reconciliation-wizard.
prerequisites: You are signed in as accountant and can access Ledgers.
Route /accounting/ledgers is reachable and module data is loaded without blocking errors.
Required records and permissions for open-reconciliation-wizard are available before execution.
steps: Verify active workspace/company context before running open reconciliation wizard.
Open the exact workflow action labeled for open reconciliation wizard.
Enter required fields for open reconciliation wizard (entity selection, date range, and status where applicable).
Apply changes and execute open reconciliation wizard with explicit confirmation in the UI.
Validate result rows/totals/artifacts on the same page before navigating away.
If output is generated (report, export, invoice, or link), verify it is accessible and associated with the same context.
Record resulting reference IDs or filenames for traceability and follow-up.
validations: The open-reconciliation-wizard action completes without permission or validation errors.
Resulting state is visible immediately in Ledgers lists, metrics, or related output panels.
Output artifacts remain linked to the same entity/date context used during execution.
commonErrors: No data returned because filter/date/entity scope is missing or inconsistent.
Action appears successful but output record is not persisted or linked.
recovery: Reopen /accounting/ledgers, reapply field values, and rerun open-reconciliation-wizard with a narrowed scope.
Refresh session and confirm role permissions for accountant before retry.
Cross-check logs/output panes and relink missing artifacts to the correct context.

faq.question: How do I open reconciliation wizard?
faq.answer: Open Ledgers at /accounting/ledgers, run open reconciliation wizard with required selections, and validate table/list + output artifacts before closing.

faq.question: How do I troubleshoot open reconciliation wizard if results are missing?
faq.answer: Recheck filters, dates, selected entities, and permissions; rerun and confirm row counts/totals update in place.
